title: The Tangkhul Folk Poetry in Song (HAOLA)
title_translation: The Tangkhul Folk Poetry in Song
notes: Comprehensive research compilation of Tangkhul oral poetry and musical chants catalogued at CIIL Bhasha Sanchika.

lines_tangkhul: Hao laawui khon kongrei thata ngaloong.
lines_translation: The melody of Hao Laa flows like an untamed mountain river.
The sacred oral poetry of our ancestral fathers and mothers.
Echoing joyous harmony through hills and forested gorges.
